front: State the time-distance-speed equations.
back: GS=D/t; t=D/GS; D=GS×t. Knots are NM/hour.

front: How are fuel used, endurance and range calculated?
back: Used=flow×time; endurance=usable fuel/flow; range=endurance×GS. Use only stated reserves; exclude unusable fuel.

front: How do you calculate direct recovery to destination?
back: Track error≈60×XTE/distance flown; closing angle≈60×XTE/distance remaining; add both.

front: How do you calculate a revised ETA?
back: Remaining distance ÷ actual GS, added to present time; retain elapsed real time.

front: What is the signed direction-conversion chain?
back: TH=TC+WCA; MC=TC−VAR; MH=TH−VAR; CH=MH−DEV. East positive, West negative.

front: How do you calculate QDM from an RBI?
back: QDM≈MH+RB; normalize 000°–359°. The needle head points to beacon.

front: How should you interpret a VOR CDI?
back: Read OBS course and TO/FROM flag first; then CDI and aircraft quadrant. Radial is magnetic FROM station.

front: How do you calculate PET with different groundspeeds?
back: x=D×VR/(VR+VB); VR=GS back, VB=GS onward. Equal groundspeeds put PET halfway.

front: What are standard holding patterns and wind corrections?
back: Normally right turns unless published otherwise; correct drift inbound/outbound and adjust outbound time to hold tracks.

front: State turn load-factor and radius formulas.
back: n=1/cosφ; r=V²/(g tanφ), g=9.81 m/s². At 3°/s, r=V/ω; do not mix assumptions.

back: Chart edition/scale/projection/variation; coordinates; airspace limits/class/hours; aerodrome/navaid data; terrain/hazards.
